pages.text: Stirs a Basin by hand: mixing recipes, shapeless crafting and automatic brewing.\n\nHold right-click on the basin. The fluid surface animates while you stir.

pages.title: Recipes it can do
pages.text: $(li)Create's $(l)mixing$() recipes$(br)$(li)Shapeless crafting that Create allows in a mixer$(br)$(li)Automatic brewing$(br)$(li)Exclusive stirring recipes\n\n$(italic)Shapeless support depends on Create's $(c)allowShapelessInMixer$() setting.$()

pages.title: Tips
pages.text: $(li)Empty basins and unmatched recipes don't waste durability.$(br)$(li)Mixing cycles at a fixed interval; check JEI for the exact recipes.
